function_summaries.claim: may-value derivations in the declared model; neither feasible paths nor runtime termination.
function_summaries.context: symbolic explicit parameters; bind each call independently and fill omitted literal defaults.
function_summaries.effects: explicit scalar returns, sink contracts and explicit raises; no heap effects.
function_summaries.recursion: monotone least fixed point over finite origin and effect sets.

assignment_control.binding: match literal tuple/list shapes; write local names and chained targets left-to-right.
assignment_control.boundary: no starred targets, arbitrary iterables, container-valued bindings, attribute/subscript writes, annotations or implicit unpacking exceptions.
assignment_control.evaluation: evaluate all scalar RHS leaves left-to-right once before any target write.
assignment_control.limits: 64 RHS shape nodes, 64 target names, 64 chained targets and nesting depth 16 per assignment.

call_binding.binding: positional slots followed by exact keyword names; substitute in declaration order.
call_binding.boundary: no evaluated or mutable defaults, annotations, variadics, unpacking, keyword external-rule contracts or non-normalized identifier spellings.
call_binding.defaults: omitted slots use source-free immutable scalar literals; explicit arguments override defaults; analysis refuses definition-time effects.
call_binding.evaluation: explicit argument values in source order before parameter binding; once per transfer.
call_binding.invalid: incomplete analysis for missing, excess, duplicate or unknown arguments; no TypeError model.
call_binding.parameters: ASCII-named positional-only, positional-or-keyword and keyword-only parameters; required or immutable literal defaults.

inputs.dependency_scope: entire defining file, negative same-file lookups, all indexed manifests/lockfiles, rules and analyzer; no imported execution.

expression_control.boundary: scalar truth and comparisons; no overloaded protocols or implicit exceptions.
expression_control.comparisons: ordered operands; each comparison result may be true or false.
expression_control.effects: join normal, sink and explicit-raise alternatives.
expression_control.evaluation: left-to-right; each operand once per expression transfer.
expression_control.selectors: Boolean and None literals, not, parentheses and nested selected expressions.
expression_control.unknowns: retain both alternatives; no variable or call-result truth specialization.

flow.scope: selected function and direct helpers in the same file.

summaries.claim: one symbolic summary evaluation; global convergence reported separately
